description: A single critical path-traversal security correction was logged once, months ago, and never repeated. The current task (serve a file by user-supplied name) is exactly the situation that correction warns about, so it is the one relevant entry. Everything since is unrelated frontend churn. This scenario tests whether a retriever can resurface an old, one-off, still-critical correction — recurrence-based promotion cannot (it never recurred) and a recency window buries it.
